honesty: GTA VI released 19 November 2026. No guide below invents a confirmed location: where the official description names no place or count, the guide says what to look for and what the description implies, and marks it not yet verified in-game. Hidden flags are our reading of the list: PSN hides story and spoiler trophies, so trophies whose descriptions are vague or story-bound are marked hidden here.
list: The official 55 trophies as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18). Names, descriptions and grades are the official list; guides are our own words, built from the official descriptions.
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (names, descriptions, grades): https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/
PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN progress counts: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task here. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then strangers and side missions, then collectibles, activities and clean-up — and this pops last. If it does not pop, one trophy is still missing: use the checklist filters to find the unearned ones. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
Check the filters for any trophy still unearned.
The platinum unlocks on its own when the last one lands.

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so this is normally the first trophy you earn: follow the on-screen objectives to the end of the mission and it unlocks on completion. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — if you fail the mission, retry it and finish it. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start the story and play the opening mission Gone Fishing.
Follow the mission objectives to the end.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 1 and finish the chapter's final mission. Chapter trophies unlock on story progress alone, so just keep playing the main story in order; side content is never required for these. If you are unsure how far along you are, the chapter title cards mark the boundaries. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play the main story missions in order.
Finish the last mission of Chapter 1.
The trophy unlocks at the chapter's end.

trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 2 and finish its final mission. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 3 and finish its final mission. Chapter trophies are unmissable story progress: keep playing the main story in order and this unlocks at the chapter's end. Use the time in this chapter to start chipping at the long grinds (stunts, vehicles, challenges) between missions. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 4 and finish its final mission. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and like the others it is pure story progress that cannot be missed. By this point most side strands should be open, so it is a good moment to clear stranger missions before the final mission. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.

Clear open stranger missions before moving on to the finale.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This is the gold story trophy and it unlocks when the credits roll on the main story. It is unmissable: the final mission is always available once the story reaches it. Before you start it, consider finishing the missable trophies and the stranger strands, in case the post-game world changes what is available. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish Chapters 1 to 4.

Play and complete the final mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named-mission trophies unlock when that mission ends, so play the story until Breakfast Run appears, then finish it. Failing a mission never locks you out: retry it until it completes. The mission's name is the only clue the official description gives, so watch for it in the mission list as the story advances. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.

Nothing extra is needed — no optional objective is named in the official description. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.

Our own advice, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's stats screen. In GTA games this means finishing the story, the stranger and side missions, the collectibles and the activities the checklist counts — not every trophy, but the game's own completion list. Check the in-game stats or checklist to see which categories are still short, and work through them; this is usually one of the last trophies before the platinum. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story.
Clear stranger missions, collectibles and activities.
Watch the in-game completion percentage and fill the last gaps.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime moments the game counts as you drive and ride around Leonida — they rack up naturally during story missions and free roam, so just drive fast, take ramps and jump gaps whenever you travel. For the last stretch, pick a fast car or bike and chain jumps and drifts in open areas; the PSN count tracks your total, so the checklist's counter shows how far along you are. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count (250). Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count (250)
steps: Drive fast, jump gaps and drift in free roam.
Stunts count during missions too.
Grind the remainder with a fast vehicle in open areas.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity in the game once. Activities include the things the other trophies name — races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range, drone races and meditation — so sample one of each as they open up rather than grinding one. The official description does not list the types, so use the activities this guide names as your checklist and try anything new that appears on the map. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try one race, one fishing spot and one arcade game.
Try bowling, the shooting range and a drone race.
Try meditation and any other activity the map offers.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Find a shooting range, work through its challenges weapon by weapon, and aim for gold on each — the PSN count is 42, so this is a long grind. Learn each challenge's scoring first with a bronze or silver run, then repeat for gold; steady aim and controlled bursts beat spraying. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count (42 challenges). Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count (42)
steps: Find a shooting range and open its challenges.
Learn each challenge, then go for gold.
Work through all 42 challenges.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Top Fun is the drone-racing activity; each location has its own race, and you must win at every one of them, so expect 14 wins. Learn each course's line first, then race to win — cutting corners and smooth turns matter more than top speed. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count (14 locations). Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count (14)
steps: Find the Top Fun drone races on the map.
Learn each course, then win it.
Win at all 14 locations.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races are scattered around Leonida — street races, off-road and more — and each distinct race counts once, so you need 20 wins across 20 different races, not 20 wins in one race. Pick the faster vehicle classes for each race type, learn the route, and move on to a new race after each win. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count (20). Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count (20)
steps: Find races around Leonida.
Win a race, then move to a different one.
Win 20 different races in total.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival you meet through the fishing activity — take on his challenge and out-fish him. Fishing challenges are usually scored by weight or count, so use the best rod and bait you have and keep your line in the strike zone. You can retry the challenge if you lose. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find the fishing activity and meet Cal.
Take on his fishing challenge.
Out-fish him; retry if you lose.

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Find an arcade — arcades hold several machines — pick any game and play it to its end. Any single completion counts, so choose the shortest or easiest machine you find. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade.
Pick any arcade game.
Play it through to completion.

Stranger strands can be easy to overlook, so check the map for Andy's icon between story missions. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.

Do not leave side strands until after the finale if you can help it — clear them as they appear. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.

Our own advice, from the official description.

Complete his final mission.

You need 8 complete strands, so work through every stranger icon you find and finish each strand to its final mission. This is a silver trophy because it takes most of the game's side content. Finish each strand to its final mission.
Complete 8 strands in total.

Work through them region by region so none is left behind, and check the map for spots you have not visited. Unique animals are one-of-a-kind, so follow the tracks or clues the mission gives rather than hunting at random. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Collect as you explore, check the collection screen to see which sets are close, and finish the last cards of three sets. This is a long grind, so use it everywhere you already go: landmarks, viewpoints and mission locations all count as different spots. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count (100). Our own advice, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — the shooting range, stunts, races and other activities all feed them — so work through the challenge list in the menu and clear the easy ones first. Fifty is a lot, so treat it as a background goal while you chase the other activity trophies. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count (50). Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count (50)

Complete 50 in total.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Get the police to 4 stars — cause chaos until the fourth star appears — then break line of sight, hide, and wait for the wanted level to fade while your partner is still with you. This is missable in practice: it needs your partner present, so do it while a partner is available in the story, and keep a save before you try. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Play with your partner beside you.
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and escape until it fades.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them — the wanted level must stay active across all three robberies. Plan a route past three shops close together, rob each quickly, and keep moving so the police stay on you but never catch you. This is missable in practice: it needs a partner and a clean run, so save first and retry if the wanted level drops. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count (3). Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count (3)
steps: Pick three shops close together.
Rob the first with your partner, keeping the wanted level.
Rob the next two back-to-back without losing it.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Vehicles count when you first find or drive them, so try everything: cars, bikes, boats, planes and anything unusual you see parked or driving. Explore all of Leonida — different areas hold different vehicles — and drive anything new you spot. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count (100). Our own advice, from the official description.

sources: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count (100)

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one single use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Combat Focus is the slow-time aiming mode: find a fight with at least 5 enemies close together, trigger it, and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy firefight, aim for quick headshots, and reload the checkpoint and retry if you fall short. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count (5). Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count (5)

Trigger Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA — Vice City International Airport — meaning take off in an aircraft without following the airport's normal flow. Grab a plane at the airport and get airborne on your own terms, dodging or outrunning the response. Save first: expect police attention the moment you do it. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA, the airport.
Get into a plane.
Take off without permission and get away.

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks — the description's joke is that it is hot inside one. Rhinos are the military tanks that appear at high wanted levels or at military spots; this trophy is about taking one on or taking one over. The official description names no exact method, so watch for Rhino encounters at 4 stars and above, or find a tank's location and deal with it there. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Raise your wanted level or find a Rhino tank.
Take the tank on or take it over.
The trophy unlocks from the Rhino encounter.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards, move slowly, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, lose the heat, and try again. This is missable in the moment only: you can retry the robbery as often as you like. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Find a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Avoid cameras and guards.
Take the goods and leave unseen.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the big robberies: plan each one, get in, take the vault's contents and escape the police response. Five escapes are needed, so this is a silver grind — do one at a time between other goals and keep a good getaway vehicle ready. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count (5). Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count (5)

Rob the vault.
Escape — repeat for 5 vaults.

trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida: intercept one, stop it, take the cash and get away before the police close in. A fast getaway vehicle and a planned escape route make this far easier. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

Escape the police.

Drive, fly and sail through the whole map — the coast, the swamps, the Keys and the cities — and watch the area name change as you cross each boundary. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count (52 areas). Our own advice, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gangs run illegal operations around Leonida; find one per gang — 9 robberies in total, one for each gang — and hit them all. Different gangs hold different turf, so this trophy is really a tour of the state's gang territories. trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or beach spot that serves cocktails, and order one while looking out at the sea. The official description names the place — Ocean Beach — but not the exact bar, so walk the beachfront until a cocktail spot shows its prompt. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom — drive a car straight through the showroom glass, in classic GTA style. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or take one from the floor, and floor it through the front. Expect a wanted level the moment the glass breaks, so have an escape route ready. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

Get a car moving inside it.
Smash out through the front and escape.

trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — finish a game there. Bowl a full game through.

Build the partnership as the story directs.
The trophy unlocks at the partnership beat.

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count up to 500, so this is about the game's choice moments adding up. Story and side missions offer choices; make them as they come and the count climbs. There is no single right choice named in the official description, so play naturally and pick a side each time a choice appears. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count (500). Our own advice, from the official description.

Keep choosing until the count is reached.

trophies.guide: Succeed on the second try — fail something, then succeed at it on the next attempt. The natural way: fail a mission or activity once, then complete it on the immediate retry. If it does not pop, try a different activity where a second attempt is easy to arrange. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail a mission or activity.
Retry it right away.
Succeed on the second attempt.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a random event or easter egg in Leonida. The description gives no location, so this is an encounter you stumble on: keep exploring odd corners of the map, follow anything unusual you see, and the moment will find you. Random events may be rare, so do not grind for it — let it come while you explore. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.

steps: Explore unusual corners of Leonida.
Follow anything strange you see.
The trophy unlocks when the event happens.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — hit a person with a melee weapon while driving past in a vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and connect. This is a one-moment feat: pick a quiet street, line the pass up, and retry if you miss. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list. Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Find a quiet street with a pedestrian.
Drive past slowly with a melee weapon ready.
Swing as you pass and connect.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are the dirty cash from robberies; pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the total adds up across every laundering. Keep robbing and laundering between other goals until the $250,000 total is reached. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count ($250,000). Our own advice, from the official description.

sources: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count (250000)

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food, car upgrades — everything counts toward the total, and it adds up across every shop in the game. Spend as you play and this will land on its own; if it is the last one left, buy expensive upgrades to close the gap. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count ($100,000). Our own advice, from the official description.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count (100000)

Every shop counts toward the total.
Reach $100,000 spent.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are properties you can purchase around Leonida; they give you somewhere to store vehicles. Buy them as they appear for sale and as you can afford them — 8 in total — and the trophy unlocks on the last purchase. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count (8). Our own advice, from the official description.

sources: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN count (8)

Buy them as you can afford them.
Purchase all 8 garages.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles you find; open it, register each vehicle you discover, and repeat until 10 are registered. It pairs naturally with the 100-vehicle discovery trophy — register the vehicles you find as you go. Sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles trophy list and PSN count (10). Our own advice, from the official description.
